description: This file defines the ActivationTaskScheduler class, a specialized task scheduler for per-activation work scheduling within the Orleans runtime. It manages task queuing, execution, and inline execution logic, and includes logging and optional statistics collection.

classes.name: ActivationTaskScheduler
classes.description: A single-concurrency, in-order task scheduler for per-activation work scheduling in Orleans, handling task queuing, execution, and inline execution logic.

methods.name: GetScheduledTasks
methods.description: Returns the tasks currently scheduled on this scheduler.

methods.name: RunTaskFromWorkItemGroup
methods.description: Executes a given task from the work item group.

methods.name: QueueTask
methods.description: Queues a task to the scheduler.

methods.name: TryExecuteTaskInline
methods.description: Determines if a task can be executed inline and executes it if possible.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the scheduler.
